note: Backtest figures span 2009-2025 and OVERLAP the model's own optimisation window, so they are in-sample-ish and should not be read as out-of-sample skill. nfelo straight-up 0.6674 vs market 0.6677 over n=4053 is a difference well inside noise (SE 0.20 pp).
